title: Adopt SpecSync 5.0.1 and Trust 1.0.0 governance for Swift ASA Viewer
description: Adopt SpecSync 5.0.1 and Trust 1.0.0 governance for Swift ASA Viewer
no_spec_change_rationale: This migration changes governance and CI orchestration only; Swift ASA Viewer public APIs, iOS behavior, live Pera API integration boundary, and DocC publication are unchanged, and no canonical spec currently exists.
acceptance_criteria: SpecSync strict validation passes at advisory threshold 0; all four agents report installed; Trust doctor and native verification pass; SwiftLint iOS simulator build unit tests and live Pera API integration tests pass; the existing coverage upload and DocC Pages workflow remain intact.
